cards.front: Recall a key point about Matrices
cards.back: Multiplication: (AB)_{ij} = Σₖ A_{ik}B_{kj} -- non-commutative, associative, distributive

cards.front: Recall a key point about Matrices
cards.back: det 2x2: |a b; c d| = ad - bc; det 3x3: cofactor expansion or Sarrus

cards.front: Recall a key point about Matrices
cards.back: Inverse 2x2: A⁻¹ = (1/det)[d -b; -c a]; 3x3: adj(A)/det(A) via minors/cofactors

cards.front: Recall a key point about Matrices
cards.back: System AX = B: if det(A) != 0, X = A⁻¹B (unique solution); if det(A) = 0, either no solution or infinite

cards.front: Recall a key point about Matrices
cards.back: Transformations: reflection in x-axis [1 0; 0 -1], rotation by θ [cosθ -sinθ; sinθ cosθ]

cards.front: Recall a key point about Matrices
cards.back: Eigenvalues λ: det(A - λI) = 0; Eigenvectors: (A - λI)v = 0

cards.front: Recall a key point about Matrices
cards.back: Diagonalisation: P⁻¹AP = D (D diagonal) if A has n linearly independent eigenvectors
